tools_helpful.evidence: Bulk Windows.UI.Xaml -> Microsoft.UI.Xaml rewrite + scaffold produced a building project; final build SUCCEEDED and scored 100.

tool_limitations.limitation: Only rewrites Windows.UI.Xaml.* namespaces; non-Xaml input namespaces (Windows.UI.Input, Windows.Devices.Input, Windows.UI.Colors) are left untouched, so pointer/gesture/color code fails to compile until hand-edited.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Document the pointer/gesture/Colors error cluster prominently in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md so the agent fixes it in one pass.

failed_apis.why_tried: Held the result of PointerRoutedEventArgs.GetCurrentPoint() in a Windows.UI.Input.PointerPoint variable.
failed_apis.root_cause: In WinUI 3 GetCurrentPoint()/GetIntermediatePoints() return Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint; the UWP-namespaced type is incompatible.
failed_apis.fix: Use using Microsoft.UI.Input; and type locals as PointerPoint/PointerPointProperties from there.

failed_apis.root_cause: PointerPoint.PointerDevice property was removed in WinUI 3.
failed_apis.fix: Read PointerPoint.PointerDeviceType directly; PointerDeviceType enum is in Microsoft.UI.Input, not Windows.Devices.Input.

failed_apis.root_cause: Both Windows.UI.Input.HoldingState and Microsoft.UI.Input.HoldingState were in scope (CS0019); WinUI 3 args use the Microsoft.UI.Input enum.
failed_apis.fix: Drop the Windows.UI.Input using / fully-qualify Microsoft.UI.Input.HoldingState.

failed_apis.root_cause: Colors static class moved to Microsoft.UI.Colors (the Windows.UI.Color struct stays in Windows.UI).

special_apis.special_handling: Moved from Windows.Devices.Input to Microsoft.UI.Input in WinUI 3; reachable directly as PointerPoint.PointerDeviceType.

errors_encountered.error: CS0234: The type or namespace name 'Colors' does not exist in the namespace 'Windows.UI' (x8)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Colors palette moved to Microsoft.UI.Colors; bulk rewrite only touches Windows.UI.Xaml.
GetCurrentPoint() returns Microsoft.UI.Input.PointerPoint but locals/usings still referenced Windows.UI.Input.
errors_encountered.fix: using Microsoft.UI.Input; and type locals from that namespace.

errors_encountered.error: CS1061: 'PointerPoint' does not contain a definition for 'PointerDevice' (x4)
errors_encountered.fix: Use PointerPoint.PointerDeviceType; PointerDeviceType enum in Microsoft.UI.Input.

errors_encountered.error: CS0019: Operator '==' cannot be applied to operands of type 'HoldingState' and 'HoldingState' (x2)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Two same-named HoldingState enums in scope; WinUI 3 event args use Microsoft.UI.Input.HoldingState.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove stale Windows.UI.Input using / fully-qualify the Microsoft.UI.Input enum.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold .csproj enables <Nullable>; ported UWP fields/properties were not null-annotated.
errors_encountered.fix: Left as warnings; build still succeeded. Low leverage.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated rebuilds failing on a cluster of CS0234/CS0029/CS1061/CS0019 errors all rooted in Windows.UI.Input/Windows.Devices.Input/Windows.UI.Colors not being migrated.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~19 error lines across several build iterations
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: The bulk namespace rewrite only handles Windows.UI.Xaml; the input/colors namespaces and the PointerPoint shape change (PointerDevice removed) are not covered anywhere prominent in the skill.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Switched to using Microsoft.UI.Input;, fully-qualified Microsoft.UI.Colors and Microsoft.UI.Input.HoldingState, and read PointerPoint.PointerDeviceType directly.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A dedicated, prominent 'Pointer/gesture/Colors input errors' subsection in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md's 'Common build errors' section enumerating each error and its one-line fix, plus a Windows.Devices.Input -> Microsoft.UI.Input namespace-table row.
